//: Copy to shows/<id>.json to add a built-in experience — or skip this file entirely and use the producer page's 'New show' button, which compiles a description into this format for you (saved under DATA_DIR/shows/). For a NEW character: host 1-4 reference stills (~1024px) and a 5-15s clean voice clip on fal storage first (see PLAN.md — same flow used for Tilly), then paste the URLs below. Omitting them falls back to the platform's env-level references, so don't omit them for a non-Tilly character. Generate the show's filler library + cached opening/closing once with: npm run fillers -- --show <id>
title: Display Title

character.name: CharacterName
character.visualAnchors: identity anchors prefixed to every prompt: age, look, hair, one garment, one distinctive accessory

//cast: OPTIONAL: additional recurring characters for multi-character shows. Each needs the same shape as character (speaks: true/false controls voice seeding at build time). The director picks who appears per scene (max 2) and their references condition that clip.

format.premise: One or two sentences: what this show is.
format.suggestionMeaning: what a !prompt means on this show, with an example — shown to viewers as the chat hint while live
format.characterVoice:
- Bullet points describing how the character speaks.
- Include the register (sentence length, contractions).
- Include hard 'never' rules.
- Empty string on shows where nobody speaks.
format.sceneInstructions: How the director should write scene prompts: what a scene shows, comedy shape, any recurring visual devices.
format.hostSet: the host set, described for generation
format.openingRiff: Fixed opening line, spoken to camera. Empty string when hostRiffs is false.
format.closingRiff: Fixed sign-off, spoken to camera. Empty string when hostRiffs is false.
fillerPrompts: 2-5 full generation prompts (anchors + set + a small wordless bit of business + 'No dialogue.') that air whenever generation falls behind
format.//optional: The three fields below unlock chat mechanics beyond scene suggestions:
format.interactionRules: OPTIONAL: how the director interprets !prompt messages (what counts as a vote / environment nudge / director's note, how conflicts resolve).
format.stateInstructions: OPTIONAL: what running state the director tracks between cycles (scores, leaderboard, story progress) and how it evolves. Enables votes, competitions, and ongoing journeys.
